welcome_lead: Stamp the world of Pedro Almodovar, Spain's most famous director.

walkthroughs.body_html: Almodovar's first films channelled the Movida's energy. International recognition came with Mujeres al borde de un ataque de nervios (1988). He won the Foreign Language Oscar for Todo sobre mi madre (1999).
Almodovar's films explore women, sexuality, family, and Spanish identity in saturated colours. Recurring stars include Carmen Maura, Penelope Cruz, and Antonio Banderas.
El/la director(a) = director. El guion = screenplay. El rodaje = shoot. El reparto = cast. La banda sonora = soundtrack.
